name: ref diagram 2
ascii:
Legend: `[D]` = data structure, `(O)` = operation. Every named box maps to source code.

                         SHARED PPO RUN LIFECYCLE

 (O) Compiled Puffer Backend Build and Load
       |
       | build / import / verify
       v
 (O) Shared PPO Run Lifecycle
       |
       +----> create ----> [D] Native PuffeRL Runtime State
       |                        |
       |                        | policy / optimizer
       |                        | rollout and train buffers
       |                        | CUDA graphs / streams
       |                        | counters / log windows
       |                        | optional frozen bank
       |                        |
       v                        v
 (O) Shared PPO Update, Diagnostics, and Checkpoint Lifecycle
       ^                        |
       |                        | default update
       | prepare / override /   v
       | close             (O) Native Rollout, Train, and Log Bridge
       |                        |
 [D] PPO Training Environment  +---- rollouts ----> update `global_step`
     Lifecycle Extensions       |
                                +---- train ------> (O) Compiled PPO Learning Kernel
                                |                         |
                                |                         | transpose `(T,B)` to `(B,T)`
                                |                         | normalize / anneal schedules
                                |                         | advantages / priority replay
                                |                         | PPO backward / Muon update
                                |                         | capture or launch CUDA graph
                                |                         | refresh replay / `epoch++`
                                |                         v
                                |                  synchronize / profile
                                |
                                +---- log --------> one destructive snapshot
                                                       |
                                                       +-- `env`
                                                       +-- averaged losses, then clear
                                                       +-- profile fields, then clear
                                                       +-- NVML / CUDA / RSS
